_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Anjeun keur maén Golf (Kartu) - Pamaén {player_id}.
Tujuan: Meunang skor total panghandapna dina giliran tunggal ieu. Upami kolom boga nilai nu sarua, maranéhna dijumlahkeun jadi 0.
Nilai Kartu: A=1, 2-10=nilai éta sorangan, J/Q=10, K=0

Aksinya (gunakan tanda kurung nu éksak):
- '[draw]' - Ngunduh tina dék
- '[take]' - Ngambil tina gundukan bebéwaran
- '[swap X Y]' - Ngaganti kartu nu geus diunduh jeung posisi X (baris) Y (kolom)
- '[discard]' - Ngabéwarakeun kartu nu geus diunduh

board.drew:
Anjeun ngunduh: {card}
Ayeuna anjeun kudu [swap X Y] atawa [discard]
board.took:
Anjeun ngambil: {card} tina gundukan bebéwaran
Anjeun kudu [swap X Y] jeung éta (teu bisa dibéwarakeun)

options.final_turns: Giliran pamungkas! Pilihan anjeun: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Anjeun kudu: [swap X Y] (teu bisa miceun kartu ti tumpukan dipiceun)

message.knocked: Pamaén {pid} diketok! Unggal pamaén séjén meunang hiji giliran deui.
message.final_round: Pamaén {pid} {reason}! Unggal pamaén séjénna meunang sakali deui

invalid.wrong_action: Gunakan aksinya nu dibeureumkeun: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], atawa [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Anjeun kudu mimitian [draw], [take], [knock], atawa [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: You cannot discard a card taken from the discard pile. You must swap it.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Anjeun geus ngunduh kartu. Anjeun kudu [swap X Y] atawa [discard] éta
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Anjeun kudu kartu digambar pikeun miceun.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posisi di luar wates. Gunakan baris 1-{max_row}, kolom 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Anjeun teu bisa ngetok jeung kartu digambar. ngalengkepan giliran anjeun mimiti.
